candidate.rationale: The ToOwned trait already declares ensures res.deep_view() == self.deep_view(). Adding the same per-impl postcondition is redundant and caused the verifier harness error (it referenced `res` out of scope). Keep the specification at the trait level rather than adding an identical impl-level ensures.
risks: If a future implementation needs a stronger, implementation-specific postcondition, it won't be recorded here (the trait-level spec still applies).
None related to correctness for this impl — skipping avoids duplicate/harness errors.
